saveplayers.heading: Players in this save
saveplayers.loading: Loading the players of this save…
saveplayers.reading: Reading the newest save to find its players. This takes about a minute. The list appears here when it is done.
saveplayers.unavailable: The players of this save cannot be shown right now.
saveplayers.no_save: This world has no save yet, so there are no players to list.
saveplayers.never: Foreman has not read the players of the newest save yet. It reads them by itself only while no game is running.
saveplayers.unsupported: The players cannot be read from a save of this game version, so only the time Foreman sees itself counts.
saveplayers.tracked_since: Foreman has tracked this world since {when}. Time before then is not known.
saveplayers.inexact: These play times may be a little off. A crash, or a time when Foreman was not watching, may have hidden some play time. Reading the save again fixes them.
saveplayers.total: Total play time of this save: {time}
saveplayers.before_foreman: Played before Foreman tracked this world
saveplayers.nobody: No one has joined this save.
saveplayers.read.first: Read players from the newest save
saveplayers.read.memory: While a game runs, reading needs about as much memory as the game uses now: {memory}.
saveplayers.read.memory_unknown: While a game runs, reading needs about as much memory as the game uses now.
saveplayers.failure.image_missing: The save could not be read, because this world's game image is not downloaded.
saveplayers.failure.out_of_memory: The save could not be read, because the game ran out of memory.
saveplayers.failure.timeout: The save could not be read, because the read took too long and was stopped.
saveplayers.failure.mods_differ: The save could not be read, because the mods that loaded are not this world's mods.
saveplayers.failure.save_newer: The save could not be read, because a newer game version made it.
saveplayers.failure.bad_output: The save could not be read, because the game gave no result Foreman can use.
saveplayers.failure.other: The save could not be read.
